judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a scene set on top of a solid-looking cloudscape that serves as the ground.
Include a hot air balloon with a large envelope featuring vertical red and white stripes and a brown wicker basket.
The balloon's basket must be resting firmly on the surface of a large, flat-topped cloud.
Show ropes connecting the balloon's envelope to the basket.
Include four human figures styled as a family: two adults and two children.
Position one adult figure holding a corner of a red and white checkered picnic blanket, while one child figure holds the opposite corner, as if they are spreading it out together on the cloud.
requirements.note: The blanket is already spread flat on the cloud. The woman stands on it with her arms hanging down and her hands resting on its surface, and no child holds anything; no figure grips a corner, so the two-person spreading pose is absent.

requirements.text: Place an open picnic basket on a corner of the blanket that is already spread out.
requirements.note: The basket sits at the middle of the blanket's left edge - its contact footprint is about 11% across the blanket's width but 60% of the way from the far edge to the near edge, i.e. in a mid-edge cell rather than a corner cell.

requirements.text: A thermos, a bunch of grapes, and a sandwich must be visible emerging from the open picnic basket.
requirements.note: Only a baguette emerges from the picnic basket. The orange thermos bottle, the bunch of purple grapes and the sandwich plate are all drawn separately on the blanket, none of them emerging from the basket.

requirements.text: Position the second adult and second child near the landed hot air balloon, with the adult pointing up at the balloon's envelope.
requirements.note: No child stands near the balloon, and the adult who does (the man in green) holds a hamper with both hands rather than pointing up at the envelope. The second adult is at the blanket, about 350 px away.

requirements.text: The background must be a clear blue sky containing a bright yellow sun and two small, distant clouds.
requirements.note: Five small distant clouds are drawn in the sky - at roughly (85,90), (420,125), (625,45), (545,245) and (890,225) - not two.
